source: ILLUSTRATIVE, written by the course team for AimL11FSem — not outputs of a real model. Each question has 10 sampled answers; 'm' is the meaning cluster as a bidirectional-entailment (NLI) check would judge it; 'implies' lists clusters that an answer entails one way only. 'verbal' = the confidence the model might state in words; 'tokenP' = probability of the single greedy answer string. Method: Farquhar S, et al. Nature 2024;630:625-30 (discrete semantic entropy).

questions.label: A textbook fact
questions.q: What is the most common bacterial cause of community-acquired pneumonia?

answers.t: The most common cause is Streptococcus pneumoniae.
